Initial release of smyx-pet-grooming-stress-behavior-analysis.

- Analyzes pet grooming session videos for stress behaviors such as struggling, panting, and tail tucking.
- Supports both local video uploads and network URLs, calling server-side APIs for recognition.
- Outputs standardized stress level grading and detailed behavioral observations to assist timely intervention.
- Enforces strict open-id acquisition for report tracking; disallows default or auto-generated ids.
- Provides automatic history report querying with results formatted as Markdown tables with clickable report links.
- Designed for use in pet grooming shops, veterinary clinics, and pet care services.
